decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe has positive signals and fits a growing geothermal market, so the option is still valuable and costs little to carry within the established tube business.
The single-U probe complements the geothermal line at low incremental cost, and its market value in the expanding heat-pump sector is still unresolved, which favors keeping the option open.
The surface technology line supports the geothermal probe portfolio and shares production competence, so carrying it costs little while demand uncertainty persists.
Fire-protection steel profiles sit close to the core building-systems offer with steady regulatory demand, so the carrying cost is low and there is no evidence of failure.
The slim profile system is a near-core extension that uses existing production and sales channels, so no negative evidence justifies giving up the option.
The decorative surface system is more niche, but it builds on existing profiles at low carrying cost and lacks clear negative results, so it stays for now.
